title: campomanesia lundiana
intro: Campomanesia lundiana, commonly known as the White Guava, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is a tropical shrub native to the northeastern parts of South America, known for its edible fruits and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Campomanesia lundiana include its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
